title: 2026 UK ETS SAF small-emitter monitoring-plan proposal QA controls

sources.title: Treatment of sustainable aviation fuel consultation accessible webpage
UK Emissions Trading Scheme for aviation: how to comply

facts.source_fact: All aircraft operators are eligible to claim SAF emissions reductions when eligibility conditions are met.
Current monitoring-plan SAF requirements sit in a part of Annex 1 that applies only to operators that are not small emitters.
The Authority proposes amending the UK ETS Order so SAF monitoring-plan requirements apply to all aircraft operators.
The proposed change specifically concerns monitoring-plan requirements related to SAF emissions-reduction claims.
facts.expected_handling: Do not broaden to unrelated plan requirements.

facts.source_fact: Small-emitter status would not itself remove SAF claim evidence requirements under the proposed approach.
The consultation seeks stakeholder agreement on applying these requirements to small emitters.
The proposal is an operational/legal change rather than a new measured-emissions dataset.
Final implementation was targeted no earlier than a future Authority decision, with broader SAF changes viewed toward 2028.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mark proposal as current law.

facts.source_fact: A monitoring-plan requirement does not prove a SAF claim or emissions reduction without supporting evidence.
facts.expected_handling: Keep plan and verification gates separate.
